notes:
Original acquisition: DOI landing page not full text; Unpaywall/OpenAlex no OA location; SSRN 403 not retried; alternative route not usable full text. Original statistics not imported from the replication paper. Painting evaluations interpreted as main liking/quality interaction, not monetary value, comparative judgments, or mediation.
Source follow-up: Selected primary indirect-comparison quality interaction, the test matching painting evaluations; supplied p.3 locator instead contains the Experiment 2 introduction/method start. Actual test is PDF p.4. Several distinct painting tests also appear (value, direct preference and mediation); these were not merged. Analytic N left null because only subgroup recruitment counts and df are printed. Published 2004 article copy; source PDF target pages rendered and inspected. Numeric values follow the rendered printed decimal points; canonical TXT quote glyphs (colon/¼/ð/Þ) are preserved verbatim.
